The spacious rear seats provide ample room for passengers, while the Durabed pickup bed offers uncompromising utility.

Whether you're tackling tough job sites, navigating rugged terrain, or simply seeking a premium full-size truck, the 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD ZR2 is the ultimate choice. A 2024 Ford F-150 Lariat 4WD equipped with the legendary 5.0L Coyote V8, Black Appearance Package, Twin Panel Moonroof, Pro Access Tailgate, and Tow Package delivers the perfect combination of power, capability, luxury, and style.

Finished in Agate Black Metallic, this truck has an unmistakable presence. It's bold.

The legendary 5.0L V8.

No turbos.

No compromises.

The Bed Utility Package adds even more capability with LED box lighting, tie-down plates, and practical features that make loading, unloading, and securing cargo easier than ever.

Then you step inside.

And that's where the Lariat separates itself from the crowd.

Premium leather-trimmed bucket seats.

Connected Navigation.

Dark interior accents.

Power tailgate.

Pro Access Tailgate.

Premium materials throughout.

The Twin Panel Moonroof completely transforms the cabin, flooding the interior with natural light and creating an open-air driving experience that passengers love.

And one of the most talked-about features on the redesigned F-150 is the Pro Access Tailgate.

It's one of those features you don't realize you need until you use it.

The integrated access door makes reaching cargo easier, especially when a trailer is attached, making everyday truck ownership more convenient.

This truck isn't just about luxury.

It's built to work.

The 7,100-pound GVWR package, four-wheel drive system, locking rear differential, and proven 5.0 V8 make this an ideal truck for towing, hauling, jobsite duties, camping trips, and everyday driving.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
